edges.effect_quant: Different designs and subgroups point in different directions, so a single pooled estimate is not the right way to read this edge.
edges.mechanism: High-dose vitamin D has sometimes raised concern for falls, potentially through overshooting physiologic signaling or intermittent hypercalcemic effects in susceptible adults.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2023 Zittermann meta analysis in Eur J Nutr, which ties vitamin d about 4000 iu/day to falls in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Subgroup differences, dose thresholds, and competing mechanisms likely explain why the literature does not settle into one clean direction.
